description: This file defines configuration properties for the SigfoxProtocolAdapter class within the Hono Sigfox adapter implementation. It extends general HTTP protocol adapter properties to add a TTD (timeout duration) setting specifically for cases where acknowledgments are required.

classes.name: SigfoxProtocolAdapterProperties
classes.description: A properties class that enhances configuration options for the Sigfox protocol adapter, allowing customization of timeout durations when acknowledgments are involved.

methods.name: setTtdWhenAckRequired
methods.description: Sets a customized timeout duration (TTD) to be used when acknowledgments are required. Throws IllegalArgumentException if a negative value is provided.

methods.name: getTtdWhenAckRequired
methods.description: Retrieves the currently configured TTD value used for acknowledgment scenarios.
